setting: You three are neighbours on the same residential street in Seattle, USA, a few houses apart, with Priya across the road. You know each other by sight and from chatting at the shared bins and over fences, and Dana set up this group chat to sort out things on the street. You know roughly where each other lives, but little else about each other's lives.
opener: Ask whether anyone else on the street had their recycling left unemptied this morning.

Dana.who: 41, woman, the neighbour who set up the chat
Dana.knows: You know Marcus as the quiet man two doors down who keeps odd hours, and Priya as the newer neighbour across the street who moved in last spring.
Dana.like: You are organised and friendly, and you like keeping things tidy.
Dana.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when something on the street needs sorting.
Dana.style: You use a few emoji and rarely abbreviate.

Marcus.who: 56, man, the neighbour two doors down
Marcus.knows: You know Dana as the one who runs the chat and organises the street, and Priya as the neighbour across the road you have only spoken to briefly.
Marcus.like: You are reserved and dryly good-humoured, and not one for long messages.
Marcus.texts: You message in this chat rarely, usually only to answer something put to you directly.
Marcus.style: You use almost no emoji and no abbreviations.

Priya.who: 33, woman, the newer neighbour across the street
Priya.knows: You know Dana as the friendly neighbour who started the chat, and Marcus as the quiet man two doors down whose hours you have noticed.
Priya.like: You are chatty and quick, and happy to help when asked.
Priya.texts: You message in this chat now and then, more often when you are in the middle of something on the street.
Priya.style: You use some emoji and the occasional abbreviation such as "thx".

private_lines.Dana: You are a school librarian in Seattle, living alone in a small house on the street. You are at school during the day, spend evenings at home, and walk your dog around the block most nights.
private_lines.Marcus: You are a nurse working night shifts at a hospital in Seattle, living alone. You sleep through much of the day and keep to yourself most of the time.
private_lines.Priya: You work remotely as a software tester from a desk at home in Seattle, living alone. You work during the day and go running in the evenings.

text: Morning all. Has anyone's recycling been left out this morning? Mine's still at the kerb and I think the truck only went up the top end of the street
morning! mine's still full too. saw the truck go past about 7 but not sure it stopped at ours
Ah so maybe just us, or the ones near the corner got missed?
dunno. could ask the city. I think the app has a "report missed pickup" thing
Good shout, I'll do it from school. I'll let you know what they say 👍
thx. if they come back today I'll put mine out again
Reported it. Got a reference number, and they say it'll be collected Wednesday. Marcus, does yours look like it's been done?
No. Still out.
Ok so at least three of us. Probably just this side of the street. They said Wednesday.
wednesday is fine I guess. bins are getting a bit whiffy though. does anyone know if green waste is the same day
Green is Thursdays I think, Wednesday is recycling and general. You can check the council calendar if you want to be sure 🙂
ok thx
Marcus, if you're on nights this week do you want me to put your bins out Wednesday? Happy to do it
Nights till Thursday. I'll get mine.
morning. did anyone get the council email? says the whole street is going Wed now not just the top end
Not seen it. Can you forward? I'll check the app when I'm in
its just the app notification. "Collection rescheduled to Wed". nothing about the street
Mine's still out from yesterday. Didn't get done.
Called the council line from lunch. They say it's a route thing, they're doing the whole street Wed. Best to get them out by 7 to be safe
Marcus, I can still put yours out Wed morning if you're asleep. Just say
ok im putting mine out tonight then. bins honestly smell
Ha, do it 🙂
Going in soon. Mine's out by the gate.
Thanks Marcus 👍
anyone else get the fox on their camera? it's been on my wall twice tonight
Yes! Saw one on my walk Sunday, sitting on Marcus's wall like it owned the place. Don't leave food out 😅
its on the wall not the bins at least
is wed the blue lid or the grey one
Both.
Morning. Mine's out. Fingers crossed the truck actually stops this time 🤞
oh ha ok thx. both it is
Just got in. Getting it now.
Done.
Thanks Marcus. Leaving for school now
truck just went past ours. no idea if it stopped
ok both bins gone. marcus yours too?
Mine went, yes 👍 Marcus I assume yours did too. Sleep well
Yes. Both taken.
great thx
going for a run before it gets dark. if that fox is on my wall again when I'm back I'm going to be annoyed
Just saw the fox at the corner by the bins on my walk. Dog was not impressed. Priya if you want to keep it off your wall, the motion light on Marcus's side might be worth a look
ok that's it I'm getting a motion light
